points.description: States "Consensus" as a principle of ISO standards.
States "Industry-wide applicability" (applicable across all industries/sectors) as a principle.
States "Voluntary nature" (voluntary adoption/standards) as a principle.

rubric.notes: All three principles are required with the correct technical names: consensus, industry-wide applicability, voluntary nature. Each correctly named principle earns its own share; a wrong extra item (a fourth, incorrect principle) cancels the mark for one point. Vague or generic wording (e.g. "quality", "standardization") earns nothing. Total is 2 marks, so award 2 only if all three are correct and no wrong extras; two correct earns about 1.
